title: Home slot and receipt contract for v2 Home layout writes (Home4)
description: SP-400, a newly authored owner contract under DL-045 (2026-11-04): the successor slot and receipt schema that SP-330 and SP-273 require before a native v2 Home layout writer is admitted. Same physical families, keys, producer id, custody, transaction, crash, retention, read and withdrawal rules as Home3 (SP-273). It replaces only what Home3 types for v1 layouts and the 1.1.0 payload, and the JSON and base64 encodings DL-270 retires. pm.home_workspace_layout.v2 and the CV-361 2.0.0 payload are referenced by $ref, never copied. A complete value over its family's 16 KiB limit (SP-340) is stored as a fixed-size reference to its canonical bytes in the payload store (SP-337), defined by stored_value_ref.
$comment: Stored as canonical MessagePack (SP-339, DL-270): a property described with contentEncoding base64 is MessagePack bin in the stored value and base64 only in this JSON projection; no stored field is base64 text. Semantic invariants the schema cannot express, checked by scripts/pm_home_layout_v2_slot_receipt.py: I1 binding.command_id = owner_result.command_id = event payload command_id = the original normalized request, SIR outcome and UI response command_id; the payload change is never migrated_from_v1 (the v1-to-v2 conversion has no admitted command and stays in SP-330's StorageMigrationCoordinator transaction; SP-273: migration values never authorize making up a command or receipt). I2 binding.expected_layout_revision = receipt.prior_layout_revision = owner_result.prior_layout_revision = payload.prior_layout_revision = prior_layout.revision; for prepared and committed receipts new_layout_revision = prior + 1 = owner_result.new_layout_revision = payload.new_layout_revision = event producer_sequence_id = readback.layout_revision = candidate_layout.revision. I3 binding, slot, readback and payload name one Project and workspace tab; readback.canonical_key = home_workspace_layout.v2:{project_id}:{workspace_tab_id}; event_semantics.project_id and both layouts' project_id and workspace_tab_id equal the binding's. I4 payload.command_result_ref = owner_result.result_ref = dispatch_receipt.command_result_ref; payload.receipt_refs = [dispatch_receipt.receipt_ref]; payload.correlation_id = binding.correlation_id = event_semantics.correlation_id = dispatch_receipt.correlation_id; payload.interaction_transaction_id = binding.interaction_transaction_id; event_semantics.actor_ref = binding.actor_ref; dispatch_receipt.dispatch_ref = binding.dispatch_ref; payload.settled_layout_ref = receipt.settled_layout_ref = home_layout_settlement:{operation_digest}, and readback.layout_sha256 = settled_layout_sha256; a committed result and receipt name the event. I5 operation_digest = lowerhex(SHA256(RFC8785([storage_instance_id,project_id,workspace_tab_id,command_instance_id]))) and the event ID, idempotency key and home_layout_* refs are formed from it exactly as SP-273 defines. I6 SHA-256 of the exact layout source bytes (inline bytes or the resolved payload-store object) equals prior_layout_sha256 or candidate_layout_sha256 and the bytes decode to the decoded layout; inline source bytes are at most 16,384 bytes and a source payload_ref is used only above that (SP-273, SP-337). I7 each identity_capture_bytes member is the canonical MessagePack encoding of the matching original typed value, and identity_capture_bytes_sha256 is SHA-256 of those bytes; core_bytes is the canonical MessagePack encoding of core and core_sha256 its SHA-256. I8 original_command_outcome.owner_result_schema_ref (and the UI response's, when present) = {path: Plans/home_layout_v2_slot_receipt.schema.json, json_pointer: #/$defs/owner_result, schema_id: pm.home_layout_owner_result.v1}, and owner_result_sha256 = original_owner_result_sha256 = the CV-333 RFC 8785 SHA-256 of owner_result. I9 a prior migration wrapper joins the slot: logical key home_layout_transaction_slot.v1:{project_id}:{workspace_tab_id}, Storage instance and scope, and successor generation, migration, completion time and receipt key and hash equal the slot's migration_generation (SP-273). I10 the complete stored value, its canonical MessagePack encoding with every contentEncoding base64 field as bin, is at most its family's max_value_bytes in Plans/storage_value_registry.json (SP-340; 16,384 bytes) when stored inline; a larger value is stored only as stored_value_ref, and a stored_value_ref names only a larger value; the reference itself is within the limit. I11 a payload reference (a source payload_ref or a stored_value_ref's value_ref) resolves: the object exists, its bytes hash to blake3_id (BLAKE3, exactly 64 lower-case hex characters), its length equals byte_size and its media type equals media_type; for a stored_value_ref, value_sha256 is the SHA-256 of those bytes, which are exactly the canonical MessagePack encoding of a Home4 value of the named schema_id that passes this schema and I1 to I10, and the reference's logical_key and storage_instance_id equal the value's (I3). A reference that does not resolve makes the value unavailable: SP-273's missing-or-corrupt rule fences the scope. Patterns use ECMA-262 semantics: `$` is the end of the input, so no identifier accepts a trailing line break. Readers dispatch by schema_version: 1.0.0 to 3.0.0 through Plans/home_layout_value_readers.schema.json, 4.0.0 through this contract. Native installation, codecs, redb transactions, authentication and durability remain NOT_RUN.

core_bytes.description: MessagePack bin in the stored value (SP-339); base64 only in this JSON projection.

bytes.description: MessagePack bin in the stored value (SP-339); base64 only in this JSON projection.

media_type.description: RFC 6838 type/subtype of the referenced source bytes.

blake3_id.description: BLAKE3 payload-store id (SP-337): exactly 64 lower-case hex characters. The length bounds pair with the pattern so that no validator dialect accepts a trailing line break.

sha256_hex.description: SHA-256 as exactly 64 lower-case hex characters.

stored_value_ref.description: SP-400 reference form (2026-11-04): the redb value stored at a Home4 slot or receipt key when the canonical MessagePack encoding of the complete Home4 value exceeds its family's max_value_bytes (SP-340; Plans/storage_value_registry.json storage_profile, 16,384 bytes for both families). The complete value, its decoded layouts, source bytes and event fields included, is the payload-store object the reference names (SP-337); a reader resolves it before any use. It is never written for a value within the limit.

logical_key.description: The exact redb key the reference is stored under; it equals the key formed from the referenced value.

byte_size.description: Length of the complete value's canonical MessagePack bytes; always above the family limit.
